query:
SELECT 
  channel,
  COUNT(*) as sent,
  SUM(gotReply) as replies,
  ROUND(SUM(gotReply)/COUNT(*)*100,1) as reply_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN replySentiment='positive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive,
  SUM(dncTriggered) as dnc
FROM message_outcomes 
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH) AND channel IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY channel ORDER BY sent DESC;
